01

“creation after creation”

An explanation transmitted from ʿIkrima (Q 39:6).

848
Explanation from ʿIkrima No. 848: 1

ʿIkrima

English
Transmission wording
848: 1. Sufyan, from Simak ibn Harb, from Ikrima, on the words of God
"creation after creation": He said, a drop, then a clot, then a lump of flesh; "in three darknesses": he said, the placenta, the womb, and the belly (verse 6).
العربية
848: 1 سفيان عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ خَلْقًا من بعد خلق قَالَ نُطْفَةٌ ثُمَّ عَلَقَةٌ ثُمَّ مضغة في ظلمات ثلاث قال المشيمة والرحم والبطن (الآية 6) .
